title: Twelve Feet of River
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（自然与环境·江河湖海）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（自然与环境·江河湖海）　|　核心词汇：boat　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 boat 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 my mother was sent to bail ① a boat she could not row, and she said the rowing was the whole of the lesson. The ② boat, meaning the hull and not the river, was twelve feet long and was taken out by whoever came last; a boat, she said, is the only thing on a river that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ boat in that harbour had the same rope, and the ④ boat at the end, meaning the one the ferryman kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever painted properly. A boat, my grandmother said, is nine parts timber and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the timber is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ boat was the whole of the crossing, meaning the passage and not the hull. The ⑥ boat, meaning the crossing and not any of that, is the only thing on a river that everybody pays for and nobody questions; a boat, he said, is either something you bail or the only word that means both a hull and a crossing. She said the crossing is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ boat had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the timber. The ⑧ boat of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was twelve feet of river and eleven years of rowing; a boat, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ boat I remember is the one at the end, which was mended in 1975 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ boat, my grandmother said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being rowed; every boat, she said, is a crossing that has agreed to look like a hull. She said the crossing was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 船（指船体本身，与河流相对）
C. 固定搭配：bail a boat 把船里的水舀出去
D. n. 船（指港里每一条）
E. n. 船（指尽头那一条）
F. n. 摆渡；渡河（抽象：与船体相对）
G. n. 摆渡（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a boat she could not row
The boat, meaning the hull and not the river
boat was the whole of the crossing
the boat had become a photograph in a report
The boat of the whole thing
A boat, my grandmother said in 1977

answers.why: bail a boat 意为“把船里的水舀出去”，1957 年母亲被派去舀一条她划不动的船。
boat 意为“船”，指船体本身而不是河流，长十二英尺，由最后走的人划出去。
boat 指港里每一条船，每一条都是同样的缆绳。
boat 指尽头那一条（船夫留的那一条），是唯一有人认真刷过漆的。
boat 意为“摆渡、渡河”，与船体相对，父亲说 boat 就是那次过河的全部。
boat 为抽象用法，指摆渡这件事本身，是河上人人都付钱、却没人质疑的东西。
boat 意为“小船、船”，到 1971 年这条 boat 成了报告里的一张照片。
boat 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是十二英尺的河面和十一年的划船。
boat 意为“船”，我记得的是尽头那一条，1975 年修过，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
boat 为抽象总称，祖母说船是唯一会因为被划动而变好的东西。
